provenance: Verbatim copy of dndk_gcm_test_vectors.json from the draft's [DNDK-TV] reference (https://github.com/Shay-Gueron/DNDK-GCM, commit fe27db54e31399eb889a27f935a431a7d80f6a8d, 2026-09-14). The file itself names draft -04; draft -05 (2026-09-16) cites the same repository in Appendix A and its Appendix A.1-A.4 values equal tcId 1-4 here. The 'appendixA' array below is transcribed from draft-05 Appendix A, including intermediate values.

notes.AppendixA: Known-answer test from draft Appendix A
notes.SingleByte: Minimal non-empty plaintext and AAD (1 byte each)
notes.CorruptedTag: GCM tag modified, decrypt must reject
notes.CorruptedKC: KC value modified, decrypt must reject
notes.WrongCounter: Counter value changed, decrypt must reject
notes.KCModeMismatch: KC-mode output decrypted without KC (or vice versa)

tests.comment: Round-trip: Empty plaintext, empty AAD, KC=off
Round-trip: Single-byte plaintext, single-byte AAD, KC=off
KC mode mismatch: decrypt A.1 as KC=off
Round-trip: Empty plaintext, empty AAD, KC=on
Round-trip: Single-byte plaintext, single-byte AAD, KC=on
